titre: habits of people who are never bored #boredom #curiosity #habits #selfimprovement #mindset
notes: Inspiré d'un contenu du label weird_alpha qui a marché chez nous (@mentoridaily, 1b1d2c9b). full test BLEO : accroche jamais faite (format « habits of people who are never X »). cta A. Slide Sophia en position 4.

slides.texte_overlay:
habits of people who
are never bored

they notice small things

they pay attention to the details others walk past: an odd building, a strange bird, a funny sign. the world is full of tiny stories for anyone who looks closely.

they keep a project going

they always have something on the go, like a garden, a sketchbook or a model to build. a slow personal project turns empty evenings into something to look forward to.

they learn a little daily

people who are never bored always have one new idea to think about: a myth, a planet, a painting. they collect them on purpose, a few minutes every single day.
slides.texte_sophia:
they learn a little daily

i used to get bored so easily. now i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app, a myth or a planet, and my mind always has something interesting to chew on.

slides.texte_overlay:
they ask good questions

they turn every conversation into a little adventure by asking people what they love and why. other people's lives are endlessly fascinating if you really ask.

they enjoy doing nothing

they can sit on a bench and watch the world without reaching for a phone. being comfortable with quiet moments means boredom has nothing to grab onto.
